scoring_justification: All reported quantities are recomputed from the agent's own intermediate values using the prescribed formulas; the checker verifies that the CSV is internally self-consistent and that EC strings match the computed totals.

outputs.description: The main reproduction artifact: a table of computed atomic properties for selected 3d metals in f.c.c. and s.c. in f.c.c. structures, reproducing the key quantities from the paper’s Table 2.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares each numerical column against hidden reference values (the paper’s reported numbers) with a tolerance, and verifies electron configuration format consistency.

steps.description: Verifies internal consistency of the computed properties table against the formulas and input data.
steps.note: The checker recomputes R from C,K; Z3d from R; b1,b2 from R and neighbor distances; Δm from Z3d,b1/b2,K,C_max; Ntot_8 from b1,Z3d,K; Ntot_9 from N_free+Δm; and checks EC string format and consistency with Ntot.
